title: Glen Oro Farm

services.name: Trail Rides
services.desc: This experience focuses on children ages 7-11 that are too young for our Trail Rides but would like some time with horses. This experience essentially mimics our full Trail Ride journey, however with a shorter window of time and focuses on getting kids comfortable with their pony. The kids will learn how to brush, mount up, the basics of riding - then be lead around one of our fields with a Trail Guide helping to build that comfort of a new skill. Following the ride, children will then give their pony some treats and some nice big pats. Photos of the experience will be taken throughout by the Trail Guide and supplied to the family afterwards. We like to call this one “the snap and snuggle”

blurb: Glen Oro Farm is a complete equestrian facility operating for over 50 years, offering horse breeding, boarding, training, and competitions. They provide experiences including weddings, glamping farmstays, and trail rides. The farm aims to connect guests with nature and educate about agriculture and horsemanship.
